env.userData: fresh temporary directory via AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA, seeded before launch with the inference.json in `seed` (the config the app wrote when Apple ran as `fm serve`)
env.launch: mkdir -p "$TMPDIR/ud-apple" && cp <seed as inference.json> "$TMPDIR/ud-apple/" && AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA="$TMPDIR/ud-apple" bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9361
env.machine: macOS 27.0 (26A428), Apple Silicon, Apple Intelligence on; `/usr/bin/fm` present but its terms NOT accepted (`fm --help` prints the legal notice and exits)
env.build: main at 51817a3 + this change (uncommitted), afm-bridge 0.3.0 debug build
env.note: Driven in consecutive cdp-drive calls against one running app; this list joins them. Model waits are polling evals. OPENAI_API_KEY is in .env (never recorded), which proves the saved Apple choice survives instead of falling back to the OpenAI default.

model: apple-fm · system (Apple Foundation Models on device, answered by the app's own afm-bridge `chat` method; no fm serve, no port)

actions.type: 霧散後才浮現的漂流群島，島民用風箏把貨物送到鄰島，每天傍晚要點燈替迷路的風箏引路。

actions.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){const p=document.querySelector("[data-stream-preview=world]"); if(p) window.__e2e.last=p.innerText; else if(window.__e2e.last) return {doneMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0,last:window.__e2e.last.slice(-1500),len:window.__e2e.last.length}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));} return "timeout";})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<1800;i++){const p=document.querySelector("[data-stream-preview=world]"); if(p) window.__e2e.last=p.innerText; if(document.querySelectorAll("[data-card]").length===7) return {cardsMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0}; const e=document.body.innerText.match(/錯誤 · [\w.-]+/); if(e&&!p) return {error:e[0], last:window.__e2e.last.slice(-700)}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));} return "timeout";})()
